Previous verdict incorrectly assumed this was about Charlie Kirk's father and cited wrong amount (0M vs 30M).

records.text: Israel has not been a great ally to the U.S. all the way since 1960 when they bombed the USS Liberty.
records.speaker: Student (Ep r1PS67aRmcA)

appearances.snippet: all the way since 1960 when they bombed the USS Liberty

verification.notes: FACTUAL ERROR: The USS Liberty incident occurred on June 8, 1967, NOT 1960 as claimed. The speaker misstated the year by 7 years. The attack did occur (Israel attacked USS Liberty during the Six-Day War, killing 34 and wounding ~170), but the date in the claim is incorrect. Israel apologized and called it a case of mistaken identity. The claim is marked FALSE due to the incorrect date.
